body: Filed 2026-10-05 from GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#586 (orchestrator triage T586a, read-only code survey on origin/main 019f958a; findings are code-read inferences, not runtime). - Type FEATURE, **P1**: small; independence needs to be checkable from the ledger (#480 intent), and every later generation without it is lost history. - Labels: `agent-memory`, `ideas`, `github586` - touchPaths: `.corvint/change.cem.json`, `.corvint/changes/`, `docs/specs/INDEX.json`, `docs/specs/README.md`, `docs/specs/REQUIREMENTS.tsv`, `docs/specs/corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md`, `internal/tasks/cli/lease.go`, `internal/tasks/dispatch/loop.go`, `internal/tasks/snapshot/attempt.go`, `internal/tasks/snapshot/attempt_prior_test.go`, `internal/tasks/transaction/lease_claim.go` - Acceptance: 1. A new prior-generation entry carries optional `stage`, `poolId` and `memberId` copied from the ended generation (`lease_claim.go:235`). Legacy entries decode unchanged and are re-encoded byte-identical (N-1 replay). 2. `attempt show` renders absent history fields as `NOT_OBSERVED`, never guessed. Optionally, the member is recovered only from audited receipt POST state when that state is present. 3. Claim results include `poolAllocation`, and the dispatcher `claim` event detail includes `member` (`dispatch/loop.go:1028`). 4. Read commands still write nothing (product invariant 4).

completion.reason: Every acceptance criterion is met: prior generations carry stage/poolId/memberId with byte-identical legacy re-encoding, NOT_OBSERVED rendering, poolAllocation in claim results and member in the dispatcher claim event, pure reads.
